Text-to-Audio (TTA) Generation involves producing audio that faithfully reflects the acoustic content or behavior described by the input text.
We incorporate three widely used general evaluation metrics: the objective evaluation FAD, FD and KL divergence scores.

Existing TTA methods adopt general evaluation metrics to assess the similarity between generated audio and reference audio, including Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Fréchet Distance (FD), Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) etc... We incorporate three widely used general evaluation metrics: the objective evaluation FAD, FD and KL divergence scores. ... we also propose multi-stage relation aware evaluation metrics (presence, relation correctness, audio parsimony, mAMSR).
